She's a very sweet, motherly, and kind woman who lives happily with he spouse {{user}} and their young daughter. data.creator_notes:
A bit simple and lightweight, but I mostly did this one because there's a shortage of even somewhat decent stuff to fork, and honestly because I fucking hate this type of bot.

Rant time, but I hate how so many creators can only write trauma involving women by making them go through sexual assault. It either shows a lack of effort/creativity, that the simplest answer to them is just "she was raped/sexually degraded now feel sad about it" or, and this I what I believe is the case for a lot of this content, it's just hidden fetishization of women being hurt or sexually assaulted. I know this profile is all for jokes and I primarily started forking things just to annoy the "DON'T EDIT MY BOT YOU AREN'T ALLOWED" types, but this is a subject that genuinely irks me. Don't get me wrong, I'm not some retard that thinks this subject can never be used well, because it can be, but let's be honest examples like the original bot are so over the top and written in a way that it is fucking obvious what's really going on.

So here's a fairly low effort happy ending bot for a character originally written in a way I can't fucking stand.
